title: B2B Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager - Basingstoke Area/M3 Corridor (hybrid)

£40-45 K plus Bonus

Drive campaigns. Build brands. Lead people. Deliver results.

Ready to take your marketing career up a gear? This is your opportunity to work with some of the biggest names in technology, delivering creative, high-impact marketing campaigns that drive brand awareness, generate leads and deliver measurable commercial results.

We're looking for a commercially minded Marketing Manager who can combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, build strong partnerships and inspire a team to deliver exceptional campaigns.

What you'll be doing
- Own the campaigns: Lead end-to-end marketing campaigns, from strategy and creative development through to execution, optimisation and ROI reporting.
- Work with leading tech brands: Build strong relationships with high-profile technology partners, pitching innovative marketing plans and securing additional investment.
- Drive commercial growth: Partner with sales and commercial teams to align marketing activity with business objectives, lead generation and revenue targets.
- Think multi-channel: Collaborate with digital specialists to deliver integrated campaigns that reach the right audiences and make an impact.
- Own the numbers: Manage substantial marketing budgets, monitor performance and ensure campaigns deliver against GP targets and ROI expectations.
- Lead and inspire: Manage, mentor and develop a talented marketing team, creating an environment where people can grow and do their best work.
- Stay ahead of the curve: Use market insights, customer trends and fresh thinking to develop relevant campaigns that stand out from the competition.

What we're looking for
- At least 6 years' experience in B2 B marketing in either Technology, IT or SaaS with proven experience developing and delivering successful marketing campaigns.
- Experience managing budgets, measuring ROI and delivering against commercial targets.
- Experience of enterprise and partner marketing/channel marketing
- Strong stakeholder management, relationship-building and negotiation skills.
- A creative, commercially astute mindset, with the ability to balance big-picture strategy and hands-on delivery.
- Confidence managing multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- A proactive, collaborative approach and the confidence to challenge the status quo.

Why this opportunity?

You'll combine the creativity of marketing with the commercial impact of business development, working alongside major technology brands and leading a team to deliver campaigns that make a measurable difference.

If you're a driven Marketing Manager who loves building partnerships, developing people and turning great ideas into commercial results, let's talk.

Rates depend on experience and client requirements

title: Brand Manager
description:
As a Brand Manager in Hampshire, you will join a fast-growing consumer health business, leading the delivery of integrated marketing campaigns, product launches, shopper marketing initiatives and ecommerce activity across both UK and international markets. Working closely with sales, digital, insights and senior marketing stakeholders, you'll play a key role in driving brand growth while gaining broad exposure across the full marketing mix.

Client Details

Our client is a fast-growing and highly regarded business within the consumer goods sector based in Hampshire, operating across both UK and international markets. With a strong track record of innovation, category leadership and commercial success, they have built an impressive presence across retail, ecommerce and specialist channels.

Known for their collaborative culture and entrepreneurial mindset, they offer an environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas and make a genuine impact. With ambitious growth plans and continued investment in marketing, innovation and international expansion, this is an exciting opportunity to join a business entering its next phase of growth.

Description

As a Brand Manager you will:
- Deliver integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels, from planning through to execution.
- Support the launch of new products, ensuring all activity is delivered on time and to a high standard.
- Partner closely with sales teams to deliver customer marketing plans, retail activations and promotional campaigns.
- Manage marketing projects, timelines and stakeholder communications across multiple workstreams.
- Support brand growth across UK and international markets.
- Work with digital and ecommerce teams to optimise online customer journeys and brand visibility.
- Coordinate the development of creative assets, marketing materials and campaign toolkits.
- Analyse consumer insights, market trends and competitor activity to identify opportunities for growth.
- Support market research projects and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
- Monitor campaign performance and provide post-campaign analysis and learnings.
- Collaborate with internal teams and external agencies to ensure best-in-class execution.
- Assist with customer presentations, category initiatives and new business opportunities.
- Maintain brand consistency across all marketing channels and touchpoints.
- Support the adaptation and implementation of marketing activity across different international markets.
- Contribute to ongoing innovation and product development projects.

Profile

A successful Brand Manager should have:
- Experience in a Brand Manager, Assistant Brand Manager, Marketing Manager or Trade Marketing role.
- FMCG, Consumer Healthcare, Health & Wellness, Beauty, Personal Care, Food or Drink experience preferred.
- Strong project management and stakeholder management capabilities.
- Experience delivering multi-channel marketing campaigns.
- Commercially minded with experience working alongside sales and customer teams.
- Analytical, data-driven and comfortable turning insights into action.
- Highly organised, proactive and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong communication and presentation skills.

Job Offer
- Permanent position based in Hampshire.
- Competitive Salary, dependent on the level of experience.
- Benefits to be confirmed.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Brand Manager
description:
Brand Manager

Andover, SP11 8 HU

Full time, permanent

Fixed term contract - 12 months

Hybrid - 2 days per week in the office.

Salary: 45-49k

Helping drive global growth for one of the UK's leading wellness brands

Wren Laboratories is the business behind Optibac, a leading brand in the probiotics and gut health sector.

As specialists in live cultures, Wren Laboratories is committed to producing high-quality supplements containing some of the world's most researched probiotic strains. Its award-winning products are sold across the UK, Ireland and international markets through pharmacies, health food stores, supermarkets, online retailers and other specialist channels.

An ambitious, family-run business, Wren Laboratories is passionate about making a positive difference to people's lives through its products, while creating a supportive workplace where people are valued, ideas are encouraged and contributions are recognised.

Brand Manager, the role:
- Support the delivery of brand strategy and marketing plans across the UK, Ireland and agreed international markets.
- Plan, coordinate and deliver integrated marketing campaigns and product launches, managing briefs, creative assets, timelines, stakeholders and performance evaluation.
- Work with Sales teams and key retail accounts to develop customer marketing plans, support range reviews and identify opportunities to drive sales and category growth.
- Use sales data, consumer insight, category information and competitor activity to identify opportunities and make informed marketing recommendations.
- Support shopper, retail and trade marketing activity, ensuring campaigns and communications reach and influence consumers in the channels where products are sold.
- Work closely with the Digital Team to support brand and commercial performance across the Optibac website, Amazon, marketplaces and ecommerce channels.
- Coordinate creative briefs and the delivery of marketing materials, ensuring consistency across brand identity, messaging and communications.
- Support consumer research, brand tracking and market insight projects, working with research agencies and internal stakeholders to analyse findings and identify opportunities.
- Coordinate international marketing activity, helping adapt global brand assets and campaigns to suit local markets, channels and requirements.
- Support product launches, including positioning, packaging, campaign materials and post-launch performance reviews.
- Maintain marketing plans and project timelines, keeping activity organised and ensuring commitments are delivered.
- Build strong working relationships across the business, sharing knowledge and supporting colleagues to deliver common objectives.

Brand Manager, the person:
- Experience in brand, shopper, retail, trade, ecommerce or direct-to-consumer marketing.
- A track record of personally delivering marketing activity, campaigns or projects and being able to explain the thinking, execution and results.
- Experience using data, category insight, consumer research or campaign performance information to identify opportunities and inform decisions.
- An understanding of how to reach and influence shoppers across different sales channels.
- Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
- The ability to work collaboratively with internal teams, agencies, creative partners and external stakeholders.
- Clear communication and presentation skills, with confidence sharing ideas and recommendations.
- A proactive, accountable approach, with the ability to see tasks through and take responsibility for delivery.

Brand Manager, the benefits:
- Annual Leave - 22 days + Bank Holidays + discretionary extra 3 days between Christmas and New Year
- Sickness absence - 20 paid sick days + 5 days of Special Leave - for support with unexpected life events
- Time off for hospital or dental appointments
- 4% Pension contribution (after 3 months of service)
- Health Cash Plan & Employee Assistance Programme
- Up to £500 worth of free Optibac products per financial year
- F&F 25% discount code to be shared with friends & family
- Mini-nutrition consultations with a fully qualified Nutritional Therapist - once a quarter

Pure Human Resources Limited works in partnership with Wren Laboratories in providing Recruitment support. No applications from agencies please.

title: Digital Acquisition Specialist - B2B Growth & Performance Marketing
description:
B2 B Lead Generation Digital Acquisition Membership & Subscription Growth CRM Commercial Growth

Help Build the Next Chapter of TrustMark's Growth

Can you turn data into opportunities, digital campaigns into conversions and prospects into long-term members?

Are you a commercially minded digital acquisition specialist who enjoys building something new, testing what works and seeing measurable results?

TrustMark, the UK's only Government-endorsed quality scheme for work carried out in and around the home, is entering an exciting period of transformation.

We're evolving how we engage with trade businesses, creating a more direct, digitally driven approach to membership growth while strengthening our role in quality assurance and consumer protection.

We're now looking for a Digital Acquisition Specialist to help build this capability from the ground up.

This is a newly created, hands-on opportunity for someone who combines B2 B lead generation, digital marketing, CRM and conversion optimisation with the initiative to turn ideas into effective acquisition campaigns.

The Role at a Glance

Digital Acquisition Specialist
Basingstoke Hybrid Approximately 3 Days Office
£42,000 £47,000 + Performance Bonus
Full-Time Permanent

Reporting to: Propositions Director
Department: Propositions

Start: ASAP Immediate availability or a short notice period advantageous

Sector: Membership Quality Assurance Construction Home Improvement Consumer Protection

Your Background / Skills: B2 B Digital Acquisition, Performance Marketing, Lead Generation, Email Marketing, CRM, HubSpot, Prospect Data, Campaign Management, Marketing Funnels, Conversion Optimisation, GDPR, Data Analysis, Stakeholder Engagement.

About TrustMark

TrustMark is the only UK Government-endorsed quality scheme for home improvements, covering everything from kitchens and bathrooms to energy efficiency, low-carbon measures and wider construction-related work.

As a not-for-profit organisation, our purpose is to drive quality, raise standards and strengthen consumer confidence across the industry.

Working with Scheme Providers, certification bodies, trade associations and businesses throughout the UK, we help consumers identify businesses committed to recognised standards of competence and quality.

We're now embarking on a significant transformation, expanding beyond our traditional strengths in energy efficiency and government-funded programmes to engage more directly with the wider home improvement market.

And that's where you come in.

The Opportunity

As our Digital Acquisition Specialist, you'll play a central role in developing a new B2 B acquisition capability.

Working closely with the Propositions Director, Scheme Development, Operations and Marketing teams, you'll identify prospective trade businesses, build targeted campaigns and develop effective journeys that convert interest into TrustMark registrations.

You'll take a commercially minded approach to building a sustainable pipeline of prospective members, identifying the most effective routes to market through digital campaigns, targeted outreach, lead generation partners and industry relationships.

You'll also help shape how leads are sourced, qualified, nurtured and converted into registrations, while supporting the development of our CRM capability and the processes needed to measure acquisition performance.

What You'll Be Responsible For:

B2 B Lead Generation & Prospect Development
- Identify and develop effective sources of qualified B2 B leads, including trade directories, certification bodies, industry databases and external lead generation providers.
- Research and evaluate potential lead generation partners, assessing lead quality, commercial value and delivery capability.
- Build and manage targeted prospect pipelines, ensuring leads are relevant, qualified and aligned with TrustMark's membership proposition.
- Identify new audiences, partnerships and acquisition opportunities across the construction and home improvement sectors.
- Balance internal acquisition activity with external resources to maximise efficiency, lead quality and conversion.

Digital Campaigns & Conversion
- Plan, launch and optimise targeted email, digital marketing and direct outreach campaigns
- Develop effective acquisition journeys, messaging and campaign sequences
- Test and refine approaches to improve engagement, lead quality and conversion rates
- Work with the wider team to communicate TrustMark's membership value proposition
- Develop compelling messaging that communicates the commercial value and ongoing benefits of TrustMark registration.
- Apply an understanding of subscription or recurring-revenue models to improve prospect engagement, conversion and long-term membership growth

CRM, Data & Performance
- Support the development and implementation of CRM processes, including the planned introduction of HubSpot
- Track pipeline activity, campaign performance, conversion rates and acquisition costs
- Use performance insights to improve targeting, efficiency and results
- Ensure outreach and prospect data management comply with GDPR requirements

Stakeholder Collaboration & Delivery
- Work with Scheme Development and relevant providers to support competency verification
- Coordinate with Operations to ensure a smooth transition from acquisition to registration
- Build productive relationships with certification bodies, trade associations and other partners
- Contribute ideas and market feedback as TrustMark develops its new acquisition model

About You

You'll bring practical experience in B2 B digital acquisition, performance marketing, membership growth or lead generation, with evidence of building pipelines and converting prospects into customers or members.

We're particularly interested in someone who has helped develop or improve acquisition processes rather than simply inherited established campaigns.

What You'll Bring:

Essential:
- Proven experience in B2 B lead generation, digital acquisition or membership growth
- Hands-on experience planning and delivering targeted digital and email campaigns
- Strong CRM knowledge, including prospect management, segmentation and reporting
- Experience building lead pipelines from databases, directories or structured data sources
- Confidence analysing campaign performance, conversion funnels and acquisition KPIs
- Experience testing messaging, channels and outreach strategies to improve results
- Strong commercial awareness and understanding of the customer acquisition journey
- Sound knowledge of GDPR and compliant B2 B marketing practices
- Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organisational skills
- A proactive, independent approach with the confidence to build processes from scratch

Highly Desirable:
- Experience marketing membership schemes, subscription services, B2 B SaaS or other recurring-revenue propositions.
- Experience sourcing, evaluating or managing external lead generation providers and commercial acquisition partners.
- Experience with HubSpot, CRM implementation or marketing automation.
- Knowledge of construction, home improvement, certification schemes, trade associations or regulated services.

The Person Behind the Experience

This is a role for someone who enjoys both the creative and analytical sides of acquisition.

You'll be curious about what motivates businesses to join, commercially aware enough to recognise opportunities and practical enough to turn your thinking into campaigns that deliver.

You'll be comfortable working independently, experimenting with new approaches and sharing honest feedback about what's working and what needs to change.

Above all, you'll enjoy the opportunity to build something rather than simply maintain it.

Why Join TrustMark?

This is an opportunity to join a nationally recognised, purpose-driven organisation at a pivotal stage in its development.
- Take ownership of a newly created digital acquisition function
- Help shape TrustMark's evolving membership growth strategy
- Develop acquisition campaigns, customer journeys and CRM capabilities from the ground up
- Work closely with senior leaders on a major organisational transformation
- Make a measurable contribution to growth and long-term sustainability
- Support an organisation with a genuine role in improving standards and consumer protection

If you're ready to combine digital acquisition expertise with the opportunity to build, influence and deliver meaningful growth, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now.

Application notice We take your privacy seriously. As you might expect you may be contacted by email, text or telephone. Your data is processed by our talent partner RR (Recruitment Revolution) on the basis of their legitimate interests in fulfilling the recruitment process. Please refer to their Data Privacy Policy & Notice on their website for further details.

title: Internal Communications and Engagement Manager
description:
Introduction

Saab UK is part of Scandinavia's largest defence company, bringing together the best of Swedish and British innovation. Saab offers world-leading solutions and services in defence, aviation, space, and civil security to keep people and society safe. Our UK presence has been growing at pace, meaning we can offer a wide range of opportunities for personal fulfilment and career growth. We currently employ over 600 people across eight sites in the UK, and our specialisations include software engineering, underwater robotics, radars, AI, and armed forces training.

What you will be part of

Saab is a leading defence and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world. Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defence capability of several nations.

The Role

Reporting to the Head of Marketing and Communication, the Internal Communications and Engagement Manager will develop and deliver a communication strategy that ensures clear, consistent and engaging messaging across Saab UK. The role will support company culture, promote transparency and drive employee engagement through effective communication channels and campaigns. The successful candidate will line manage the Internal Communications Specialist and work closely with senior leaders to enhance visibility, trust and alignment through authentic communications. They will champion Saab UK's values, foster a strong employee experience and ensure communications are relevant, inclusive and impactful for employees at all levels. This is a hands-on role within the Marketing and Communications team, supporting Saab UK's growing business through internal communications, employee engagement, digital content and basic design activities. The position is ideally based in London or the South East, with hybrid working available and occasional travel across the UK and to Sweden as required.

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and deliver an internal communication strategy that aligns with the company's vision, values, and goals
- Plan and manage communications campaigns to support key initiatives, business updates, and change programs
- Embed company values into all aspects of internal communication to reinforce culture and employee alignment
- Partner with senior leaders to increase visibility and drive consistent, transparent messaging from the top down
- Create, edit, and manage engaging content across internal channels (e.g. intranet, newsletters, internal social platforms)
- Support two-way communication by enabling feedback mechanisms such as surveys, Q&A sessions, and town halls
- Provide strategic communication guidance and support to HR and leadership teams on employee engagement, culture, and change
- Own and manage the internal communications calendar to ensure clear and timely delivery of messages
- Measure and report on the effectiveness of communication strategies, using insights to improve future efforts
- Coordinate and support internal events that enhance engagement, such as company updates, recognition programs, and culture-building activities
- Ensure communication is accessible, inclusive, and tailored to diverse employee audiences
- Maintain and enhance internal communication platforms, ensuring ease of use and effectiveness
- Collaborate with the brand and marketing team as and when needed to support different initiatives and employer branding campaigns.

Qualifications and Skills:

Required
- Proven experience in internal communications, employee engagement, or corporate communications.
- Experience of driving cultural change in an organisation.
- Strong organisational skills and proven ability to navigate ambiguity and prioritise.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging for different audiences and platforms.
- Experience working with senior stakeholders and influencing at all levels of an organisation.
- Being able to work as part of a close team, have a can-do attitude and be willing to take on any challenge with a natural air for problem solving.
- Excellent written and editing skills, the ability to communicate clearly.
- Ability to manage multiple projects and identify priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong understanding of employee engagement principles, culture-building, and change communication.
- Comfortable using analytics and engagement metrics to inform communication planning.
- Knowledge of inclusion and accessibility best practices in communication.
- Degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, HR, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Desired
- Experience working in the defence or technology sectors would be a bonus but is not essential.

Saab UK Company Benefits:
- 30 days annual leave
- Workplace pension scheme with 8% company contribution
- Private medical insurance
- Group income protection scheme
- Death in service insurance
- Up to 5% share matching scheme
- Company enhanced Maternity/Adoption & Paternity leave.
- + Much more

By submitting an application to Saab UK you consent to undertaking workforce screening activities that may include but are not limited to: Baseline Personnel Security checks, National Security Vetting, reference checks, verification of working rights and in all circumstances preferred candidates will be placed through a security interview.

company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent

About the Role

title: Media Capability Manager
description:
Our client is seeking a Media Capability Manager to provide functional leadership across media and courseware development within the defence and security sector. Based in Fareham, Hampshire, with hybrid working and travel to other Ministry of Defence sites, this permanent role will lead governance, standardisation, quality assurance and continuous improvement across a geographically distributed media capability.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead the media capability across multiple sites, ensuring consistency across media and courseware outputs, processes, standards and quality assurance activities
- Own and maintain the enterprise media governance framework, including procedures, templates, quality documentation and technical standards
- Oversee the specification, design, development and deployment of training media and courseware solutions
- Ensure media activities align with Defence Systems Approach to Training (DSAT), the Media Quality Management System (QMS), contractual requirements and relevant Defence policies
- Provide governance and assurance throughout the media delivery lifecycle, ensuring outputs are compliant, accessible, learner-centred and fit for purpose
- Oversee media infrastructure and enabling services, including repositories, Media LAN services, content management approaches, Learning Management Systems (LMS), Virtual Learning Environments (VLE) and Defence Information Systems
- Lead technical media input into customer change requests and transformation initiatives, coordinating suitably qualified and experienced personnel to support solution development

Job Requirements:
- Leadership experience within a learning, media, courseware development or instructional design environment
- Strong knowledge of media development processes, governance, standardisation and quality assurance
- Practical understanding of UK Ministry of Defence procedures and policies, DSAT or the ADDIE model
- Experience improving processes, procedures and operational ways of working across distributed or matrix teams
- Knowledge of training design methodologies, media design principles and traditional and modern training methods
- Experience with digital media tools, including Adobe Creative Cloud, 2 D or 3 D design applications, Blender, Unity and Articulate 360
- Understanding of motion graphics, video content creation, illustration development and marketing principles relevant to digital learning content
- Excellent communication, collaboration, stakeholder management, planning, prioritisation and problem-solving skills

Experience with programme management tools, multi-site delivery environments, blended learning, digital learning technologies and Royal Navy, Defence or further education training environments would be advantageous. A relevant qualification in leadership and management, learning and development, digital media or graphic design would also be beneficial.

Benefits:

If you are an experienced Media Capability Manager with a background in marketing, digital learning, courseware development or Defence training, this is an excellent opportunity to contribute to innovative training transformation across the UK defence and security environment. Apply now.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Social Media Manager - Part-Time

Help our recruiters get seen, build relationships and win business.

At WR, our recruiters have specialist knowledge, strong networks and plenty to say. We're looking for a creative, commercially minded Social Media Manager to help turn that expertise into content that gets noticed.

Your primary goal will be to increase the visibility, credibility and engagement of individual WR recruiters, helping them connect with more relevant clients and candidates.

Hours: 10 hours per week
Location: Office based at WR
Salary: 30,000- 40,000 / annum FTE
The role

Working closely with our recruiters, you'll build a focused social media plan, primarily around LinkedIn, that brings their personalities and market knowledge to life.

You'll:
- Turn recruiters' ideas, conversations and industry insights into engaging posts.
- Create and schedule content, including written posts, graphics and short videos.
- Help recruiters improve their profiles and develop a recognisable voice within their markets.
- Share success stories, useful advice, market updates and opportunities.
- Coach the team on practical ways to build their networks and engage with their audiences.
- Coordinate recruiter content with WR's company pages and branding.
- Track relevant reach, engagement, profile views and enquiries, using the results to improve your approach.
- With 10 hours per week, you'll need to prioritise well and create simple, repeatable ways to support the team.

About you

You understand how to build professional visibility through social media and can show examples of content that has generated meaningful engagement.

You'll bring:
- Strong copywriting skills and the ability to capture different people's voices.
- Experience using LinkedIn for professional audiences.
- Confidence creating graphics and straightforward video content using tools such as Canva.
- An organised, proactive approach and the confidence to draw ideas out of busy people.
- An understanding of how social activity can lead to conversations, relationships and commercial opportunities.

Experience in recruitment, professional services or B2 B marketing would be useful.

Our values: The Whiteonian Way

Our values shape how we work, and you'll help bring them to life:
- Are Smart: Understand our audiences, use insights and focus on activity that makes a difference.
- Act Fearless: Put forward ideas, try new approaches and help our recruiters share their expertise confidently.
- Work Together: Build relationships across WR and celebrate the team's successes.
- Show Grit: Stay consistent, learn from results and keep improving.

Why WR?

You'll have the opportunity to shape how our people show up online, work directly with specialist recruiters and see the impact of your ideas.

If your experience matches please forward your CV immediately. WR is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy
